title: Technician app - from new job to closed job
summary: Phone prototype for field technicians: the job assigned by dispatch arrives as New, the safety check gates the start of work, tasks, parts, notes and photos are captured on site, and a confirmation sheet closes the job and tells dispatch the turbine is producing again. Tested questions: does a gating checklist feel like help or paperwork, and can a job be closed in under two minutes?

items: Job list with the new job highlighted
Five confirmations, whole row is the hit area
Start work locked until all confirmed
Closed screen with the next job
First version: today, job, safety check.
Work screen, close-job sheet, offline banner.
